svg.title: Pearl Hall — A fan-shell assembly pavilion overlooking falling seawater
svg.desc: A fan of shell ribs leads to Amaya’s dais. Side galleries separate Tide Chamber, Deepvault and shrine descent; benches and a record table add small playable surfaces.
svg.text: A fan-shell assembly pavilion overlooking falling seawater
A fan of shell ribs leads to Amaya’s dais. Side galleries separate Tide Chamber, Deepvault and shrine descent;
benches and a record table add small playable surfaces.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
P1 Deepvault · P2 Gatehall of Shells · P3 Shrine Causeway · P4 The Tide Chamber
